caption: An inline comment
preconditions: Seeded item 'Party leaders agree to three TV debates before polling day' in Politics / Working; its body contains the word 'Saltmere'
Done by seed.py: The body field of the Story content profile has the 'comments' formatting option (default)

steps.name: Party leaders agree to three TV debates before polling day

steps.script: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [contenteditable="true"]'); const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); while (w.nextNode()) { const n = w.currentNode; const i = n.data.indexOf('Saltmere'); if (i >= 0) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i); r.setEnd(n, i + 8); const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); return; } } })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [contenteditable="true"]'); const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); while (w.nextNode()) { const n = w.currentNode; const i = n.data.indexOf('Saltmere'); if (i >= 0) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i + 3); r.setEnd(n, i + 3); const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); return; } } })()

notes: Flow follows e2e editor3.inline-comments.spec.ts. 'Saltmere' is selected with a DOM range (draft-js picks the selection up); a double-click on the paragraph selects whatever word sits in its centre. The comment popup opens under the Comment button, not at the word. The mention is typed slowly: with fast key presses the suggestions list does not appear. To open the saved comment, the caret is put inside 'Saltmere' (editor3 opens the comment popup from the selection). Adding an inline comment does not mark the item as changed, so Close saves it without asking (and Ignore never shows): cleanup therefore deletes the comment, saves and closes. This leaves ELECTION-DEBATE 'In progress' instead of 'Submitted' with a new version; run this page after the pages that show the Politics lists, or restore and seed.

caption: Accepting or rejecting a suggestion
preconditions: Seeded item 'Party leaders agree to three TV debates before polling day'; its body contains the word 'Eastbrook'
Done by seed.py: The body field of the Story content profile has the 'suggestions' formatting option (default)

steps.name: Party leaders agree to three TV debates before polling day

steps.script: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [contenteditable="true"]'); const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); while (w.nextNode()) { const n = w.currentNode; const i = n.data.indexOf('Eastbrook'); if (i >= 0) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i); r.setEnd(n, i + 9); const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); return; } } })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [contenteditable="true"]'); const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); while (w.nextNode()) { const n = w.currentNode; const i = n.data.indexOf('Northgate'); if (i >= 0) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i + 3); r.setEnd(n, i + 3); const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); return; } } })()

notes: Replaces 'unknown (9).png' and 'unknown (11).png'. Typing over a selection in suggestions mode creates a replace suggestion: 'Eastbrook' red and struck through, 'Northgate' green. The popup (scripts/core/editor3/components/suggestions/SuggestionPopup.tsx) shows 'Replace: Eastbrook with: Northgate' and Accept / Reject. It has no test id; locate it by the Accept button.  Capture: 'Eastbrook' is selected with a DOM range (a double-click on the paragraph hits whatever word is in its centre) and the popup is opened by putting the caret inside 'Northgate'. Suggestions, like inline comments, do not mark the item as changed, so Close saves them without asking: cleanup clicks Reject first, which leaves the text as it was (Close still adds a version and sets the item 'In progress').

cleanup.script: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-id="unsaved-changes-dialog"] button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'ignore'); if (b) { b.click(); } })()
